description: Find step-by-step replacement guide summaries and their slugs (battery, SSD, RAM, keyboard, fan, and more). Use get_repair_guide instead with a slug to read the full steps. Use get_model_parts instead when you need part numbers, not procedures. Filters combine with AND: model resolves like get_model_parts (ambiguous name → candidates; unknown → error); component must appear in the guide's component or slug; every query word must appear in the title, slug, or model name (case-insensitive substrings). With no filters it lists all guides (large). not_covered lists topics with no published steps, filtered by model and component only. Guides are paraphrased from official service manuals, not bench-tested. Formerly find_repair_guides, which still works.

model.description: Optional model slug or full name, e.g. "hp-elitebook-840-g6" or "HP EliteBook 840 G6".

query.description: Optional words, all required, e.g. "bottom cover".

name: search_repair_guides

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

title: Search repair guides
